title: Clan armies and forts
changes: Every clan's Hold is now a large isometric fort or war camp in its own style: Warden palisade, Redfang hide tents, Ossuary bone keep, Hide-Kin earthworks, Veiled sandstone shrine.
The clan that holds a land marches a column of soldiers from its Hold past its standards, and a few guards stand watch outside the walls. A weakly held land keeps fewer.
When a siege is called, a battle breaks out at each standard: both clans trade blows, some fall, reinforcements walk in. It is only for show.
